body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant mode = sanctioned exception); outermost ring always AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never `def.graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank only; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: summary pre-gate + REAL virtual probe before any migration (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2 (run #72)**: shape-based target checks are INSUFFICIENT — cell targets carry no map and are silently valid on the wrong level under plumb coordinates. The rule is SEMANTIC: when a giver's bound anchor (station/bed/bench) is on a different map than the pawn, replace ANY result it produced (job or none, thing- or cell-target) with routing or no-job. Lore updated.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair/ladder/elevator art; risers on host atlases. Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only.
- **PARITY AUDIT IS THE ROADMAP**: docs/CrossLevelParityAudit.md.

## RUN #72 FIX (2026-07-23) — APPLIED, compile green, needs relaunch
Robot Goto loop: X2_JobGiver_Return2BaseRoom emits a CELL-target Goto computed on the station's map; our thing-target map check couldn't see it, the plumb-coordinate cell completed instantly on the bot's level -> 10-jobs-per-tick breaker. Fix: both return postfixes now apply `StationElsewhere(pawn)` — bound station on another map invalidates ANY local answer -> RouteHome or clean null/NoJob. Same-level behavior untouched.

## BATCH BUILD (2026-07-23) — ALL P1+P2 BUILT, verification pending (run #72 interrupted by the Goto loop; fixed same-day)
Trade beacons column-wide (AllLaunchableThingsForTrade append + LaunchThingsOfType column debt); refuel/vat demand (supplyFuel toggle); transporter manifests; surgery-bill ingredients (pawn BillStacks; shared AddRecipeIngredientNeeds); baby food buffer; mech recharge routing (CanPawnChargeCurrently under virtual swap, 600t cd); gear probes (apparel with optimize-window handling / weapon unarmed-only / drug inventory — shared 2000t cd, VirtualScanActive recursion guard); non-Ideo gatherings (join-node postfix, rituals excluded, 600t cd); detectors: roof areas, childcare (babies), mech repair (RepairMech workType, damaged mechs). P3 excluded by design (Anomaly, anima, turrets).

## SAME-DAY PRIOR (2026-07-23, verification rolling)
Install/uninstall parity (bring-and-install + auto mini ferry); robot bounce fix (probe-gated migration, ProbeWorkAt); run #70 dock-loop fix (both patch shapes); fence patch revived; container-storage push fix (TryFindBestBetterStorageFor); verify sweep (research/fire/hunting confirmed); Achtung drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver + bring-and-build; jobs settings tab (5 flow checkboxes incl. fuel); biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs; art tuner.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab: presets + cadence sliders + 5 flow checkboxes.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art (bake fold-in pending).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (probe-gated + StationElsewhere rule, unverified). Achtung! drags (soft, unverified). Container storage destinations (unverified). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23 run #72: cell-target Goto loop found + fixed (StationElsewhere rule, doctrine upgraded to v2, lore updated). Compile green — RELAUNCH NEEDED; the whole P1+P2 parity batch plus all same-day fixes still await one full verification circuit (trade/fuel/mech-charge/surgery/robots/gear/gatherings + earlier items). Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
